brief: A windowsill planter with three herbs in soil, all visible from the front of the room, none hidden behind another.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bins bin:-1,0,0, bin:0,0,0, bin:1,0,0 in a side-by-side row (q=-1,0,1, r=0), joined with side connectors, capped and locked
fill_and_plant placed soil + prop:1 basil-young, prop:2 mint-young, prop:3 parsley-young; check_build ok, no PLANT_NOT_IN_SOIL
row runs across x at same z so no cell sits behind another; front view (az 0) look sees prop:1, prop:2, prop:3
requirements.requirement: all visible from the front of the room, none hidden behind another

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell side-by-side windowsill planter with a herb in soil in each cell, arranged laterally so all three show from the front.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Building a front-facing trio planter for your sill.
